scripts.build: npm run build:agent && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:extension
scripts.test:native: npm run build:native && CUA_TEST_NATIVE_ACTIONS=1 tsx --test tests/native.test.ts
scripts.test:reconstruction: npm run build:legacy-runtime && npm run build:rust-browser-host && tsx --test reconstruction/*.test.ts
scripts.check:reconstruction: tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.repl.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.desktop.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.sky.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.node-repl.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.extension.json && npm run check -w @core/native-host && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.native-macos.json && tsc -p reconstruction/tsconfig.runtime-supervisor.json
scripts.install:chrome: npm run build:reconstruction && npm run build:rust-browser-host && node packages/native-host/dist/install.mjs
scripts.test:native:restored: npm run build:native && CUA_NATIVE_LIVE_TEST=1 tsx --test reconstruction/native-macos-live.test.ts
scripts.test:sandbox: npm run build:sandbox && npm run build:legacy-runtime && npm run build:rust-browser-host && CUA_TEST_MACOS_SANDBOX=1 tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 reconstruction/runtime-macos-sandbox.test.ts reconstruction/runtime-cdp-sandbox.test.ts
scripts.test:native-deepseek: npm run build:native && npm run build:reconstruction && npm run build:rust-runtime && CUA_NATIVE_DEEPSEEK_TEST=1 node --import tsx --test reconstruction/native-deepseek-live.test.ts
scripts.test:rust-browser: npm run build:reconstruction && npm run build:rust-runtime && npm run build:rust-browser-host && CUA_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR=rust CUA_TEST_MACOS_SANDBOX=1 CUA_TEST_RUST_RUNTIME=1 node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 reconstruction/runtime-cdp-sandbox.test.ts reconstruction/extension-native-controller.test.ts
scripts.test:native-ipc: npm run build:reconstruction && npm run build:native && npm run build:rust-runtime && CUA_TEST_NATIVE_SKY_IPC=1 node --import tsx --test reconstruction/native-sky-ipc.test.ts reconstruction/native-deepseek-runtime.test.ts reconstruction/runtime-selection.test.ts reconstruction/restored-mcp-entry.test.ts reconstruction/native-audio-runtime.test.ts reconstruction/runtime-banner.test.ts reconstruction/runtime-tool-overrides.test.ts
scripts.test:native-skyshot: npm run build:reconstruction && npm run build:native && CUA_TEST_NATIVE_SKYSHOT=1 node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern="live owned App skyshot" reconstruction/native-sky-ipc.test.ts
scripts.test:native-app-start: npm run build:reconstruction && npm run build:native && CUA_TEST_NATIVE_APP_START=1 node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern="owned App launch" reconstruction/native-sky-ipc.test.ts
